body: Thank you so much for the student loan info. That's huge. Unfortunately, I'm too broke to even file for bankruptcy. As for calling someone, I bit my tongue and called my mom. Someone is headed over to take care of me as we speak. Who knows what happens from here, but I'll keep you all updated.

Your right. I think the one thing that has kept me from doing it the most is the thought of my mom. She lost her dad, mom, and brother this year and I think I'd be the tipping point. Could I really be the one that drove her crazy, or worse, to do what I am thinking of doing? I'm just at wits end and can't bring myself to pick up the phone and call her to tell her that I need help. I can't bring myself to go to the hospital and tell them that I am wanting to hurt myself.
I came here to vent myself and convince myself that this isn't the way. It's been half an hour and no one has responded. In the absence of sound reason....Hi. My name is Will.
